open.doc: Bring the target onto the screen: navigate, switch the tab, open the settings tab scrolled to it, expand the row, flash it.

state.doc: Read the target: value, type, options, label, disabled, enabled, rows, selection, step status, scroll position.

press.doc: Press a button or run a function (value = its argument).

set.doc: Set a setting, a tab row, or a grid selection to a value.

scroll.doc: Scroll the named (or active) container: up, down, page-up, page-down, top, bottom, or to an address inside it.

focus.doc: Scroll the target into view, select it, expand it if asked, highlight it, give it keyboard focus. Works on virtualised rows.

search.doc: Search every registered target and the search index; answers ranked hits with addresses.

list.doc: List every target on the screen in front (or under an address).

plugin.enable.doc: Turn a plugin on through the Plugin Manager.

plugin.disable.doc: Turn a plugin off; one that cannot be disabled answers invalid and says why.
